summary: Implementation plan for the Folio Premium Editorial UI/UX Overhaul & Design Audit: upgrading typography (bundled Playfair Display serif headers + Inter body), Warm Alabaster & Obsidian Ink color tokens with Muted Royal Indigo, real rendered document thumbnails, decluttered Bento tool grid, consolidated Files filter bar, unified Reader vs. Editing floating toolbars, visual page picker in the 3-Step Wizard, and tactile PIN/Signature pads.
